notes.note: Best in the last three for Robey from his 18 disposals and goal. This is about the most we should expect from him each week and anything beyond that is a bonus.
This was Robey's lowest since round 7 and he missed his BE with just 3 kicks and 6 handballs. This is a concern as his BE has jumped to 102 so you will want to trade.
Robey beat his BE and had 15 disposals. He did give away 3 frees which hurt. He has that 92 in his cycle for another week so his BE remains low at 49 but he needs another big score to keep it there.
This was one better than his season high from a couple of weeks back as he racked up 19 disposals and 9 clearances. This score means that he will keep his low BE for a couple more weeks.

Robey was a very popular trade in this week with his recent form and low BE. This was his third in the 60s in the last four and as a result his BE remains low at 13. He is just a bit too expensive now to be downgraded to.
Robey had a great game with 2 goals the result of his 22 disposals. His last three have been his best scores this year so his BE remains negative.
Robey has had two in the 60s in a row now and his BE is now down at -11 meaning he could be a handy downgrade despite having already risen in value.
Robey was quiet with his 9 disposals and his scoring isn't looking like he will make us much money.
This was Robey's second game and he has a 28 and now a 50. His BE of 22 isn't screaming pick me and there are better options for us.
